# Lyrimuse

> Real-time, word-synced desktop lyrics for Apple Music, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou Music, or Spotify on macOS — plus a Last.fm listening profile and on-device translation.

Lyrimuse is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) macOS menu-bar app. It shows word-by-word synced lyrics in a floating overlay, a Dynamic-Island-style capsule, a full Apple-Music-style lyrics window, or the menu bar itself, for whichever of five players is playing (or let it auto-detect). Lyrics are resolved from six sources (NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Kugou, Musixmatch, LRCLIB, AMLL), with on-device machine translation and per-line romanization. Once connected, it also shows a Last.fm listening profile (totals, charts, on-this-day) and a local listening history that backfills to Last.fm/ListenBrainz once you connect. It ships ad-hoc signed; no Apple Developer account is needed to build, distribute, or install it.

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/README.md): full feature list, installation options (Homebrew, manual download, build from source), FAQ, troubleshooting
- [README (简体中文)](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): 中文版功能列表、安装方式、常见问题、排查
- [Feature specification index](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/blob/main/docs/features/README.md): as-built spec, 15 chapters covering every feature's current behavior, edge cases, and code anchors
- [Releases](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/releases): per-version changelogs and downloadable builds (Apple Silicon and Intel)

## Code

- [lyrimuse/](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/tree/main/lyrimuse): the macOS app (Swift, SwiftUI + AppKit)
- [lyrimuse-collector/](https://github.com/Yudaotor/lyrimuse/tree/main/lyrimuse-collector): the background engine that resolves lyrics and artwork (Go), bundled into the app automatically

## Related projects

- [nowplaying](https://github.com/Yudaotor/nowplaying): the optional shareable "now playing" web page, plus a fork-ready template
- [nowplaying-workers](https://github.com/Yudaotor/nowplaying-workers): the Cloudflare Worker relay behind that web page, with a from-scratch setup guide
